description: The Mopo project publishes reconstructed hydropower inflow for European electricity areas from 1980 to 2023, plus reservoir and pumped-storage parameters. Zenodo lists a public 51 MB ZIP of inflow data and an XLSX parameter table under CC BY 4.0. The page distinguishes weekly reservoir inflow from daily run-of-river inflow, both in megawatt-hours, and lists the available market areas for each. These series can drive hydropower and storage operation in electricity-system simulations. They are reconstructions and equivalent-area parameters, not raw river-gauge measurements. The provider specifically says some Albanian, Bosnian and Ukrainian reservoir values were scaled from neighbouring countries because local data were lacking. It also explains that pumped-storage efficiency applies on consumption. The ZIP was not downloaded, so file format, series completeness and parameter values remain unchecked. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this hydropower package; the broad Mopo dataset is a different compiled resource.
